title: Agent rewrites full file after write-gate rejection instead of using patch_file for targeted edit
description: When patch_file is rejected by the write-gate (file not yet read), the agent calls read_file and then falls back to write_file with the full file content rather than patch_file with a targeted change. This is wasteful: write_file sends the entire file as context, produces a large diff, and risks clobbering unrelated content if the file changed between read and write. The correct recovery path is: write-gate rejection → read_file → patch_file.
proposed_resolution: Add explicit guidance to run.skill.md (and all canonical skills): after a write-gate rejection forces a read_file, use patch_file for targeted edits rather than write_file. Only use write_file if the entire file content is being replaced by design (e.g. creating a new file or a complete structural rewrite).
